summary: Make R19 shader resource creation transactional so partial VS/PS/sampler/constant-buffer failures cannot leak prior COM objects or publish an incomplete global bundle.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered GitHub HEAD 20ee3894807b8879638d711dfc5721bcab78599f. CONVERSION-DX9EX-00462 source work was not repeated: its exact SHA already passed DX9Ex Active 37415352721 and Domain Isolation 37415352672, so only stale C3-C6 bookkeeping and Issue #14 were finalized.

C1_REVIEW.evidence: CreateShaders wrote newly created VS/PS/sampler/constant-buffer COM objects directly into globals. If a later creation step failed, earlier globals survived and a retry could overwrite those pointers without Release, leaking resources and exposing a partial bundle.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Normalize any prior partial global bundle before retry; create VS/PS/sampler/constant-buffer into pending local COM pointers; rollback all pending objects on every creation failure; publish globals only after the full bundle succeeds.

code_review: Previous CreatePixelShader failure left Vs published; sampler/buffer failures left larger partial global bundles.
Retry creation previously reused the same global output pointers, so earlier COM ownership could be lost without Release.
New pending locals and rollback make publication atomic at function scope.
